# CCC

> A macOS terminal-agent recovery manager. Current runtime: guarded cmux paths
> for Codex and Claude Code. Direction: cmux outer sessions and Herdr inner panes.
> This index is documentation, not an executable integration or discovery guarantee.

- [English README](README.md): capabilities, setup and recovery boundaries.
- [繁體中文 README](README.zh-TW.md): the same quick start in Traditional Chinese.
- [Shared agent instructions](AGENTS.md): working rules for coding assistants.
- [Agent quick start](docs/agent-guide.md): verified entry points and task scope.
